page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores of an Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 32.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and it operates with a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks indicate that the ecs.sn2ne.2xlarge sits primarily in the lower-to-average tiers. Its single-core and multi-core CPU performance, as measured by stress-ng and Geekbench, falls into the bottom 25% of tested servers. However, the instance demonstrates moderate capabilities in large-block memory operations, with uncached read and write bandwidths reaching 40.42 GB/sec and 35.62 GB/sec respectively, placing it in the middle 50% tier. Cryptographic and extended instruction sets, such as AVX and AVX-512F, are supported, yielding average scores in Passmark CPU extended instruction tests.

Given its dedicated CPU allocation but older Intel Xeon architecture, this instance offers a stable, non-burstable resource profile but lacks the high-frequency performance of newer generations. This makes it a qualitatively cost-effective choice for workloads requiring predictable CPU access without needing top-tier compute speeds. It is best suited for general-purpose workloads, such as moderate web serving, basic database operations, and lightweight background processing tasks that do not demand high-speed local disk I/O or intensive single-threaded performance.
